text: Landed in 15c40fb as template v10, now LATEST: v9 with CLAUDE.md, README.md, tasks/001-start.md, src/run_tool.py and TEMPLATE.json changed, and src/gate.py unchanged. (1) README names .claude/agents/ only where a bundle has subagents, and names the permission file and runs/. (2) CLAUDE.md's Envelope says a gated tool whose contract names no opens_by opens by safety values and is refused while the file holds no entry, so an empty envelope/safety.json means no tool opens by safety values, not that no tool has a gate. The builder's Tools section (src/build/bundle.py gate_line) names the opening file on each tool's gate line, for every template. (3) src/run_tool.py, before the install the gate opens, points PIXI_CACHE_DIR, RATTLER_CACHE_DIR, PIP_CACHE_DIR, UV_CACHE_DIR, CONDA_PKGS_DIRS and XDG_CACHE_HOME at runs/cache, for its own process and what it starts. Round four's install adapter passes os.environ to pixi, so its cache would land in runs/cache unchanged; its docstring's words about the home folder are the request's to change next round. CLAUDE.md says an installer whose cache the runner does not know names where it writes in its contract. (4) The runner already read an output against the contract's outputs; it now also refuses a field of unit count below zero (execution_failure, or integrity_mismatch where the contract lists it). Declaring a value for none, or a separate field, is the request's contract; design-tool-interface could say so. (5) CLAUDE.md says a tool whose side effects are writes_files, and the checks that call it, leave folders under runs/, which a session leaves. (6) tasks/001 quotes gate: self-check ok and a replay: line that ends OK. (7) I took the second option: CLAUDE.md says a reported value's grade is the builder's to derive, and that a measured value is reported with its grade not derived, the grade being derived where the Meta-Agent takes the report into a record. Carrying the table would need a library skill for the derivation in every bundle, since a calculation in a bundle is a library skill; that is a larger choice, not taken. Tests: test_template_v10 runs the runner of a copy on an engine and an analysis tool with no side effects, plus the version diff and B6. Three of its five tests were watched failing on v9 or the old gate line. Gate: VERDICT PASS head=15c40fb, pending only this ask; meta_agent/tests 244 OK, contracts/tests 108 OK. Not pushed.
